statement: ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → 4 ≤ N → ∃ A : Set ℕ, (∀ a ∈ A, Odd a) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, (a+b)%m=N%m) ∧ ¬ (∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, a+b=N)

plain_statement.zh: 所有模数两步可达仍可漏掉指定整数
plain_statement.en: Construct a target missed despite reachability at every modulus

brief.zh: 取大于目标的所有奇数，同时平移两个加数的偶数模数倍。用它检查任何局部到整体的推理。
brief.en: Take all odd steps above the target and translate both summands by even multiples of the modulus.
